name: Strange Screentime : Alphur
source:
Strange Screentime : Alphur is a very short Visual Novel about the small conversations we can have with strangers that you didn't know they needed.

You download an old anonymous chat program called 'Alphur'. Going through various topics and meeting other people, or sometimes no one even connects. 

Listening to the radio a song comes on and prompts another topic in your mind, "80's rock". Curious, you type it in as your next topic.

Little did you know this would be your strangest encounter yet.

You meet Donnoroch. A demon curious about humans, but has never met one himself. Answer his questions and choose how you want to >respond. 

[From [url=https://mister-pann.itch.io/strange-screentime-alphur]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Strange Screentime: Alphur》是一部极短的视觉小说，讲述那些陌生人之间的小小对话——你原本不知道对方需要这些交谈。

你下载了一款名为“Alphur”的旧式匿名聊天程序。你浏览各种话题、遇见不同的人，有时甚至没有人上线。

听广播时，一首歌引出了你脑中的另一个话题：“80年代摇滚”。你有些好奇，于是把它输入为下一个话题。

没想到，这会成为你迄今为止最奇怪的一次相遇。

你遇见了Donnoroch，一个对人类充满好奇、却从未见过人类的恶魔。回答他的问题，选择你想如何回应。

[来源：[url=https://mister-pann.itch.io/strange-screentime-alphur]Itch.io[/url]]
